_README: Every record the heuristic flags is decided here by hand before it counts. `classify` refuses to report a rate while any flag is missing from this file, so no number is ever projected from an unread flag. Key is `word|pos_title`, matching the extract record. `label` is what the flagged text actually is to a reader: `definition` states a meaning, `example` shows the word in use.

serata|Sostantivo.label: definition
serata|Sostantivo.reason: 'prima serata' and 'seconda serata' are named broadcast slots, and each line says which hours it covers. That is what the phrase means, not a sentence using it.

forma|Sostantivo.label: definition
forma|Sostantivo.reason: 'forma strofa-ritornello' is defined by its parts: two verses, an interlude and a repeated chorus.

musicale|Aggettivo.label: definition
musicale|Aggettivo.reason: 'teoria musicale' is defined as the body of general concepts for composing and performing music.

osso|Sostantivo.label: definition
osso|Sostantivo.reason: 'osso di seppia' is defined as the internal shell of cuttlefish.

acustica|Sostantivo.label: definition
acustica|Sostantivo.reason: 'ingegneria acustica' is defined as the branch of engineering that builds devices to produce, transmit, record and reproduce sound.

farsi|Verbo.label: definition
farsi|Verbo.reason: The flagged line 'nelle varie forme pronominali' only heads a list, but the list it heads is definitions: 'farmi: fare + mi, fare a me' and its four siblings each gloss a pronominal form. Those sit at `#**`, one level below the example reader, so the record loses real definitions.

diametro|Sostantivo.label: definition
diametro|Sostantivo.reason: 'la lunghezza di tale retta' completes the sense above it, saying the measure is the length of that line. The italic lines around it are the usage sentences; this one is not.

servizio|Sostantivo.label: definition
servizio|Sostantivo.reason: 'servizio sociale' and 'servizio finanziario' are each given their meaning: prevention and relief of hardship, and a technical instrument for investing capital.

RIS|Acronimo / Abbreviazione.label: definition
RIS|Acronimo / Abbreviazione.reason: The `#` line only spells the acronym out. 'sezione dell'arma dei carabinieri' is the line that says what the RIS is.

esornativo|Aggettivo.label: definition
esornativo|Aggettivo.reason: 'genere esornativo' is defined as epideictic in classical rhetoric; the sibling line defines 'epiteto esornativo' the same way.

burocratico|Aggettivo.label: definition
burocratico|Aggettivo.reason: 'carte burocratiche' is defined as public documents concerning some or all citizens.

dittatoriale|Aggettivo.label: definition
dittatoriale|Aggettivo.reason: 'regime dittatoriale' is defined by how it holds power: usually military sovereignty, often formed after a coup.

incignare|Verbo.label: example
incignare|Verbo.reason: 'ho incignato il vestito nuovo' is one speaker wearing one new suit. The meaning is already on the `#` line above it.

virgulto|Sostantivo.label: example
virgulto|Sostantivo.reason: 'una pianta dai virgulti vigorosi' shows the noun inside a phrase. It says nothing the `#` line 'rampollo di pianta' does not.

spiluccare|Verbo.label: example
spiluccare|Verbo.reason: 'Edoardo ha spiluccato il biscotto al cioccolato' is one person nibbling one biscuit.

ammartaggio|Sostantivo.label: example
ammartaggio|Sostantivo.reason: 'L'... della sonda InSight e avvenuto il 26 novembre 2018' reports one landing on one date. It does not say what the word means. Flagged in the earlier 400-record draw; kept here so the earlier review's finding stays recorded.

canzone|Sostantivo.label: definition
canzone|Sostantivo.reason: 'canzone d'amore' is defined by who it is addressed to. Flagged in the earlier 400-record draw.

cruento|Aggettivo.label: definition
cruento|Aggettivo.reason: 'sacrificio cruento' is defined as a biblical offering of slaughtered animals. Flagged in the earlier 400-record draw.

partita|Sostantivo.label: definition
partita|Sostantivo.reason: 'partita semplice' and 'partita doppia' are defined by how each records transactions. Flagged in the earlier 400-record draw.
